purpose: record the MPXV5050GP supply voltage so future scale questions have a starting point; the calibration itself was NOT modified

supply_readings.method: multimeter at the sensor VCC to GND
multimeter at the sensor VCC to GND
supply_readings.note: adopted as the recording value at the operator's instruction; the two readings differ by +0.31 percent in about 15 minutes, so the rail is not a stable reference

adopted_value_reason: operator decision 2026-11-10: no stable 5.000 V source is available for a control experiment, so record the present rail instead of waiting

implications.note: the firmware slope was fitted on 2026-10-25 against the BP Pump 2 panel and implicitly assumes the supply that makes the datasheet gain equal 82.326, i.e. about 5.062 V. At 5.149 V the datasheet gain would be 80.929, so the firmware reads high by about 1.7 percent IF the part's gain is datasheet-typical.

hypotheses_not_separated.statement: supply was about 5.062 V on 2026-10-25 and has drifted to 5.149 V
hypotheses_not_separated.supports: the datasheet gain at 5.062 V is 82.320 mmHg/V, essentially identical to the fitted 82.326
hypotheses_not_separated.testable: swap in a precision 5.000 V source and see whether the fitted slope becomes 83.34

hypotheses_not_separated.statement: the supply was always about 5.149 V and this part's gain runs about 1.7 percent above datasheet-typical
hypotheses_not_separated.supports: the datasheet total accuracy is +/-2.5 percent VFSS including span, so 1.7 percent is inside the allowance
hypotheses_not_separated.testable: only with an independent pressure reference, or a known-good second sensor on the same rail

why_not_separated: no VS value was recorded at the 2026-10-25 calibration, and no stable 5.000 V source is currently available; the two hypotheses produce the same fitted slope from the data on hand

fit_quality_with_each_reading.note: predicted Tester-minus-MCU at each hold point, assuming the Tester is right
fit_quality_with_each_reading.observation: 5.149 over-predicts the disagreement more than 5.133 does, so the adopted value fits the measurements slightly worse; recorded as measured rather than rounded to a tidier number

zero_ratio_check.note: within the recorded zero drift (21 sealed holds span 3.58 mmHg, about 43 mV), so the ratiometric model is not contradicted

calibration_unchanged.reason: changing it would put the 70 already-collected exports on a different pressure scale, and the two hypotheses above cannot be separated without a control experiment or a third-party reference

limitations: the rail moved 0.31 percent between two readings 15 minutes apart, so it is not stable enough to serve as a reference itself
no independent pressure standard was available, so neither H1 nor H2 can be confirmed
the dataset pressure axis therefore carries a scale uncertainty of roughly 1 to 1.7 percent whose cause is unresolved
